skins.name: Cloud in Foreign Lands
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Cloud in Foreign Lands
skins.description: Clothes Windscoot wears while enjoying a solo trip in faraway lands during a break from work. A comfy short-sleeved shirt paired with lightweight sneakers allows him to enjoy this moment of relaxing freedom.

skins.name: Biochemical Submergence
skins.code: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/Biochemical Submergence
skins.description: Outfit of the detective who snuck into the Hospital of Horror. Falling into a mysterious liquid, his back laden with a biochemical tank that may serve as key evidence. Can he uncover the terrifying truth?

skins.name: The Chainsaw Nurse
skins.code: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/The Chainsaw Nurse
skins.description: Outfit of the nurse from the Hospital of Horror in the story. Her gigantic chainsaw and conspicuous sutures are proof enough that she, the first masterpiece, lives on to this very day.

skins.name: The Nursing Home Creepshow
skins.code: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/The Nursing Home Creepshow
skins.description: Outfit of the Dark Forest's therapist in the story. Holding poison in her right hand, her fingertips curled towards her subtle smile, making others wonder if those heavy chains are of any use.

skins.name: Under Surgical Lights
skins.code: Storyboard Breaker Serialized Comic [Beyond Redemption] Final Character Art/Under Surgical Lights
skins.description: Outfit of the doctor from the Hospital of Horror in the story. With bloodstained bandages and a wrapped-up mannequin, the mad doctor picks up his scalpel, searching for the secrets of the human body beyond ethical reach.
